label: Price too high or unclear
definition: The respondent complains about what the product costs or about how pricing is presented.
include: Too expensive, price rises, confusing plans, asks for a cheaper plan
exclude: Price mentioned as acceptable; billing support behaviour (SUPPORT)

label: Support quality
definition: The respondent complains about help from the support team.
include: Slow replies, no reply, rude or unhelpful agents
example_quote: Support took three days to reply

label: Slow performance
definition: The respondent says the product is slow.

label: Hard to use or navigate
definition: The respondent cannot find things or finds the interface confusing.

label: Other
definition: A real answer that fits no code above.

label: Uncodable
definition: Text with no usable content: n/a, gibberish, off-topic.
